summary: Iteration 26: Backtest P&L Calculation Bug Fix and WebSocket Integration - All 27 tests passed. Verified backtest engine correctly handles YES and NO positions with proper P&L calculation, and paper trader initializes WebSocket service with REST fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backtest P&L calculation for YES/NO positions and WebSocket integration in paper trader have been verified. Key methods tested: _determine_trade_side(), _open_position(), _check_exit_conditions(), _close_position() in backtest_engine.py, and start(), stop(), _get_active_markets() in paper_trader.py.

Backtest P&L - YES positions.evidence: Formula: pnl_pct = (current_price - entry_price) / entry_price. Profit when YES price goes UP.

Backtest P&L - NO positions.evidence: Formula: no_entry = 1 - entry_price, no_current = 1 - current_price, pnl_pct = (no_current - no_entry) / no_entry. Profit when YES price goes DOWN.

_determine_trade_side method.evidence: Method exists in backtest_engine.py with sentiment-based logic: >0.55 → YES, <0.45 → NO, neutral → price-based

_check_exit_conditions side-aware.evidence: Calculates P&L correctly based on position side (YES vs NO)

_close_position side-aware.evidence: Exit value calculation: YES uses exit_price, NO uses (1 - exit_price)

Paper trader WebSocket initialization.evidence: start() method initializes RealTimeMarketService via get_realtime_market_service()

Paper trader WebSocket fallback.evidence: _get_active_markets() tries WebSocket first, falls back to REST API if unavailable

Paper trader WebSocket cleanup.evidence: stop() method calls realtime_market_service.stop() for cleanup

Backend health.evidence: Backend starts without errors, /api/health returns healthy

backtest_engine.py._determine_trade_side: Correctly determines YES/NO based on sentiment (>0.55→YES, <0.45→NO) and price (>0.65→NO, <0.35→YES)
backtest_engine.py._open_position: Correctly calculates entry_price based on side (YES=price, NO=1-price), stores side in position
backtest_engine.py._check_exit_conditions: Correctly calculates P&L% based on side using proper NO formula
backtest_engine.py._close_position: Correctly calculates exit_value based on side (YES=shares*exit_price, NO=shares*(1-exit_price))

paper_trader.py.start: Initializes RealTimeMarketService for WebSocket data with try/catch fallback
paper_trader.py.stop: Properly stops WebSocket service during cleanup
paper_trader.py._get_active_markets: Tries WebSocket first (if use_websocket_data and realtime_market_service available), falls back to REST API
